critical_code_review_comments: server.py use_racial_ability endpoint does an unconditional $set of ALL 8 racial resource fields + all 8 last_used timestamps on every ability call. This is correct but wasteful — consider only $setting the fields the specific ability actually mutated (safer against race conditions if two concurrent ability calls touch a shared field).

racial_abilities.apply_sylvan_shrink: cooldown fires on BOTH toggle-on and toggle-off, then requires DB-side clear of sylvan_shrink_last_used to test the toggle-off leg. The spec says 10-min CD from last state change, which matches, but the fact that toggle-off costs no essence yet still triggers 10-min CD means players will be stuck 'Shrunken' for 10 min if they toggled on and want to toggle off immediately. Consider whether toggle-off should be exempt from the CD or share a separate short CD.

racial.py tick_racial_resources_on_action: Elf/Sylvan/Half-Elf resource accumulation is RNG-gated at 20-30% chance which makes gameplay farming slow (~30-50 actions to get 1 charge). This is by design per PRD but worth reviewing for UX — surfacing progress in the RacialAbilityPanel would help.
server.py line 1867-1887: bulk update of all 8 racial resources on every ability call is a design smell (fields for all races overwritten with existing values). Not a bug but noteworthy.
